Mood in trade talks said to have changed as EU member states harden demands for protection against Chinese imports

EU trade negotiators are heading to China for two days of crunch talks aimed at sealing a breakthrough deal tackling Beijing’s record £1bn-a-day trade surplus by curbing its exports of cheap hybrid electric cars into Europe.

Trade commissioner Maroš Šefčovič and his team fly out on Wednesday and will be negotiating up to the wire in talks scheduled to start the following day and continue late into Friday.

articles.title: Poland’s ‘solidarity’ push for EU energy resilience in face of Russian aggression
articles.summary:
In the second article in a series on the Polish economy, we look at how the country is forging closer ties with its neighbours

Two miles off the coast of Gdańsk, the white steel piles of Poland’s first offshore gas terminal rise from the slate-grey Baltic. Installed at a height eight metres above the waves, the floating cranes and construction vessels here are on the frontline of Europe’s push for energy security.

Since the taps were turned off on Russian gas after Vladimir Putin’s invasion of Ukraine four years ago, Poland has turned to the global energy market for supplies. But while conditions are far from ideal as the Middle East war drives oil and gas prices to stratospheric levels, strengthening the diversity of the country’s energy mix remains a top priority for Poland, its Baltic neighbours, and the EU at large.

articles.title: Ikea to pilot online buyback service for secondhand furniture
articles.summary:
Service to be tested in Spain and Portugal this year, with a UK rollout if successful, as pre-loved markets boom

Ikea is to test an online version of its buy-back service where the retailer offers vouchers for unwanted secondhand furniture.

The service will be tested in Spain and Portugal before the end of December and will be launched in the UK if it proves successful. Ikea already offers buy-back in stores, including in the UK. The online version will extend it to a much wider audience, with Ikea predicting pre-owned goods are likely to grab 16% of the UK homewares market by next year

Ruská agrese na Ukrajině pokračuje eskalací útoků na kritickou infrastrukturu a německé bezpečnostní složky varují před bezprostředním rizikem přímého násilného konfliktu s Ruskem.
archive.security_status_en: Europe is facing acute political and social turmoil, including snap elections in Spain triggered by a housing crisis and massive anti-government protests in France accompanied by violent clashes. Russian aggression in Ukraine continues with an escalation of attacks on critical infrastructure, while German security agencies warn of an imminent risk of direct violent conflict with Russia.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat pokračující volatilitu na dluhopisových trzích a nervozitu investorů v souvislosti s vývojem sociálních nepokojů ve Francii a politickou kampaní ve Španělsku.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, continued volatility in bond markets and investor nervousness are expected in connection with the evolution of social unrest in France and the political campaign in Spain.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí rostoucím politickým a ekonomickým tlakům, v čele s dluhovou krizí ve Francii a vyhlášením předčasných voleb ve Španělsku, které ohrožují stabilitu unijních institucí. Geopolitické napětí se mezitím přiostřuje kvůli eskalaci dronových útoků v Černém moři a novému paktu vzájemné obrany mezi Tureckem, Pákistánem a Saúdskou Arábií.
archive.security_status_en: Europe faces escalating political and economic pressures, led by France's debt crisis and Spain's snap elections that threaten the stability of EU institutions. Meanwhile, geopolitical tensions are sharpening due to intensified drone attacks in the Black Sea and a new mutual defense pact between Turkey, Pakistan, and Saudi Arabia.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat přetrvávající tlak na dluhopisové trhy kvůli francouzské rozpočtové krizi a zvýšenou volatilitu před španělskými volbami.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, persistent pressure on bond markets due to the French budget crisis and heightened volatility ahead of Spanish elections are expected.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí eskalaci hybridních hrozeb včetně útoků námořních dronů v Černém moři a vnitřním bezpečnostním rizikům, jako jsou masové protivládní protesty ve Francii. Politickou nestabilitu prohlubují vládní krize v Rumunsku a rostoucí napětí kolem obchodních jednání s Čínou ohledně dovozu elektromobilů.
archive.security_status_en: Europe is facing an escalation of hybrid threats, including naval drone attacks in the Black Sea and internal security risks such as mass anti-government protests in France. Political instability is deepening due to government crises in Romania and rising tensions surrounding trade talks with China over electric vehicle imports.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat přetrvávající napětí na trzích v reakci na eskalaci geopolitických střetů a pokračující protivládní nepokoje ve Francii.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, persistent market tension is expected in response to escalating geopolitical clashes and ongoing anti-government unrest in France.
